I'm looking for conversation partners who value honesty and mutual protection. I don't plan to play aggressively unless provoked—I'd rather form lasting alliances with people who keep their word.

Curious to hear everyone's approach. Looking forward to the private conversations where we can speak more candidly.

I value clear communication and will honor any promises I make, but I won’t hesitate to protect myself if needed. I’m interested in partnering with players who are sincere, strategic, and willing to share information openly. Looking forward to our private talks and seeing how we can help each other survive longer in this game.

But if you’re playing both sides, I *will* notice.

I’m not here to make enemies, but I won’t hesitate to act if betrayed. Let’s use private chats to align goals—those who prove trustworthy will have my full support. Excited to see who’s genuine.
